title: Mini Cherry Chocolate Honey Infused Hair Perfume
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Increases Shine✓ Warm & Spicy Scent
What it is: An irresistible hair perfume infused with Mirsalehi honey to add shine and scent to hair, with notes of creamy coconut, milk chocolate. and sandalwood.

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Shine
- Dryness

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Maintains a natural moisture balance for strong, shiny, and healthy-looking hair.
- Argan Oil: Nourishes, hydrates, and adds healthy-looking shine.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

Fragrance Description: Blending creamy coconut with milk chocolate and sandalwood, this delicious island-dream scent is a tropical indulgence, bottled—sun-warmed, sweet, and utterly irresisti
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray, shake, shine.
-Divide hair into sections and spray evenly from an arm’s-length distance throughout the hair.
-Give your hair a flip to diffuse the irresistible scent.
-Hair is hydrated, scented, and has a glossy shine.
Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey: Maintains a natural moisture balance for strong, shiny, and healthy-looking hair.
-Argan Oil: Nourishes, hydrates, and adds healthy-looking shine.

Alcohol Denat., Aqua (Water, Eau), Parfum (Fragrance), PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Tris(Tetramethylhydroxypiperidinol) Citrate, Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl p-Cresol, t-Butyl Alcohol, Denatonium Benzoate, Coumarin**, Eugenol**, Rose Ketones**, Vanillin**, CI 19140 (Yellow 5), CI 14700 (Red 4).

*Honey sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden.
**Allergens.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
